title.narrative: Lao PDR Efficiency and Accessibilty of Public

description.narrative: The project will contribute to two outcomes: (1) Public administration meets the needs of citizens through a more efficient and effective service delivery in Laos and local governance is more accountable and transparent. (2) National civil society plays a strong role in promoting effective, inclusive including for disabled people, and accountable public services while acting as a key stakeholder in national-level policy discussions. Gender equality is a key focus of the project. The proposal provides a comprehensive analysis on gender inequality among the communities across various aspects namely access to public services, literacy, and social barriers. This project is classified as GEN-2 by the UN which means that gender equality is a significant objective of the project. Although there is no explicit gender output, gender equality is fully mainstreamed into both outcomes and related outputs and, thus, integrated across all interventions.
